subject: Copywriting
title: Dave Trott: Creative Mischief
description: Learn Dave Trott: Creative Mischief in one minute.

hook.text: Dave Trott says 90% of advertising is invisible. Nobody remembers it. The only crime in advertising is being boring.

buildup.text: Trott worked in London's creative scene and wrote books distilling advertising wisdom into short, punchy stories.

discovery.text: His framework: impact, then communication, then persuasion.

twist.text: Trott argues that data-driven advertising has made everything safe—and therefore invisible. Creativity requires risk.

climax.text: His books 'Creative Mischief' and 'One Plus One Equals Three' became cult reading for young creatives worldwide.

punchline.text: 90% of ads are invisible. Be the 10% people remember.

quiz.question: What does Trott say is the first requirement of advertising?
